name: theToyBox
description: The Toy Box is a VS Code extension that bundles essential productivity tools: auto-cleanup on save, a smarter code outline for SQL/PHP/Web, custom comment highlighting, GitHub-style Markdown alerts, JSON formatting, equals alignment, real-time HTML/XML tag renaming, and Quick Notes — all in one package.

theToyBox.blockedChanges.addToGitignore.description: When enabled, automatically adds .toybox-blocked.txt to the repository's .gitignore file.

theToyBox.blockedChanges.enabled.description: Enable the Blocked Changes feature. When disabled, the Blocked Changes panel is hidden and files are not blocked from commits.

theToyBox.bookmarks.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Bookmarks panel.

theToyBox.convertSpacesToTabs.description: Convert leading spaces to tabs during cleanup.

theToyBox.ignoreTabConversion.description: List of file extensions to ignore when converting spaces to tabs (e.g., .yaml, .json).

theToyBox.ignoreTrimWhitespace.description: List of file extensions to skip trailing whitespace trimming (e.g., .md, .txt).

theToyBox.trimTrailingWhitespace.description: Trim trailing whitespace from lines during cleanup.

theToyBox.customComments.colors.description: Map special characters to hex colors.

theToyBox.customComments.enabled.description: Enable or disable custom comment highlighting.

theToyBox.customComments.excludedFileTyp.description: List of file extensions to exclude from custom comment highlighting (e.g., .md, .txt).

theToyBox.customComments.fullLineHighlig.description: If enabled, highlighting covers the entire line.

theToyBox.customComments.labels.description: Map symbols to specific label words (e.g., ! -> CRITICAL).

theToyBox.customComments.showBackground.description: If enabled, comments will have a background highlight across the entire line.

theToyBox.indentRainbow.description: Display rainbow colors for indentation levels on file load and when editing.

theToyBox.indentRainbowColors.description: Custom color palette for indent rainbow levels (hex strings, e.g. "#FFB3B3"). Leave empty to use the built-in pastel palette.

theToyBox.indentRainbowOpacity.description: Opacity of the indent rainbow background colors, as a percentage (1–100).

theToyBox.markdownHeadings.colors.description: Map each heading level (h1–h6) to a hex color.

theToyBox.markdownHeadings.enabled.description: Enable or disable heading highlighting in Markdown files.

theToyBox.markdownHeadings.fullLineHighl.description: If enabled, the background highlight covers the entire line.

theToyBox.markdownHeadings.showBackgroun.description: If enabled, headings will have a background color highlight.

theToyBox.markdownPreview.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Markdown Preview with Alerts command.

theToyBox.outline.highlightOnClick.description: Briefly highlight the line in the editor when clicking an item in the Better Outline panel.

theToyBox.showRegionsInOutline.description: Enable the Better Outline panel to show #region markers and nested symbols.

theToyBox.print.enabled.description: Enable the Print File feature. When disabled, the option is hidden from context menus.

theToyBox.quickNotes.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Quick Notes feature.

theToyBox.quickNotes.notesFolder.description: Folder where quick note files are stored. Leave empty to use the extension's built-in storage location. Use the 'The Toy Box: Reset Quick Notes Folder to Default' command to clear a custom path.

theToyBox.autoRenameMatchingTags.description: Auto-rename matching HTML/XML tags when either the opening or closing tag is edited.

theToyBox.autoRenameTag.activationOnLang.description: List of language IDs where auto tag renaming should be active.

theToyBox.autoRenameTag.voidElements.description: List of tags that are self-closing and should not be renamed.

theToyBox.performance.maxLinesForTagRena.description: Maximum file length (in lines) for auto-renaming to be active.

theToyBox.sessionRestore.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Session Restore commands.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.asp.description: Enable decoration-based syntax highlighting for Active Server Pages (ASP) Classic VBScript files.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.enabled.description: Master toggle for decoration-based syntax highlighting. When disabled, no decoration types are created and all per-language settings are ignored.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.jsSql.description: Enable T-SQL syntax highlighting inside JavaScript/TypeScript strings and template literals.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.kdl.description: Enable decoration-based syntax highlighting for KDL Document Language (KDL) files.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.nginx.description: Enable decoration-based syntax highlighting for nginx configuration (.conf) files.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.phpSql.description: Enable T-SQL syntax highlighting inside PHP double-quoted strings.

theToyBox.syntaxHighlighting.razorVb.description: Enable decoration-based syntax highlighting for ASP.NET Razor VB (.vbhtml) files.

theToyBox.todoAggregator.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Tagged Comments workspace scan panel.

theToyBox.todoAggregator.exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude when scanning the workspace for tagged comments.

theToyBox.wordFrequency.caseSensitive.description: When enabled, 'Word' and 'word' are counted separately. When disabled, tokens are merged case-insensitively.

theToyBox.wordFrequency.customStopWords.description: Additional words to exclude from the frequency list.

theToyBox.wordFrequency.enabled.description: Enable or disable the Word Frequency panel in the sidebar.

theToyBox.wordFrequency.excludeStopWords.description: Filter out common programming stop words (if, else, return, var, let, const, etc.).

theToyBox.wordFrequency.minLength.description: Minimum word length to include in the frequency list.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
